basis: Schema.org Product / PropertyValue with per-attribute provenance; sofa-specific decision vocabulary

attributes.arm_height_above_seat: Arm height minus seat height; derived, not a comfort measurement
attributes.padded_arms: Padding explicitly described or foam listed in armrest construction; not a softness rating
attributes.washable_cover: Manufacturer explicitly documents machine washing the cover
attributes.firmness: Unknown without specific vendor evidence or physical testing

side_lounge.label: Leaning sideways to read
side_lounge.meaning: Room to stretch and a padded arm contact surface; does not imply high arms are necessary
side_lounge.caution: Head support and cushion feel still need a sit test.

cross_legged.label: Sitting cross-legged
cross_legged.meaning: Prioritize usable seat depth and width, not external sofa depth
cross_legged.caution: Body size and preferred back support can change the fit.

upright_chat.label: Sitting upright to talk
upright_chat.meaning: Prefer comparatively shallower seats; no claim of ergonomic fit
upright_chat.caution: Back angle and cushion compression are not verified.

frequent_rising.label: Getting up frequently
frequent_rising.meaning: Prioritize comparatively higher and shallower seats
frequent_rising.caution: Seat height alone cannot establish ease of standing for an individual.

overnight_guests.label: Hosting overnight guests
overnight_guests.meaning: Look for documented conversion and bed dimensions
overnight_guests.caution: Bed size, mechanism and sleep comfort need confirmation.

easy_clean.label: Cleaning covers regularly
easy_clean.meaning: Prioritize documented removable, machine-washable covers for this exact version
easy_clean.caution: Washability is not evidence of stain or pet-scratch resistance.

scoring: Numeric signals use relative position within the verified catalogue, scaled 0 to 1 in the preferred direction; known less-aligned values earn less support, missing values earn none; direction and weight are explicit. Boolean documented true adds its weight; unknown adds zero and is disclosed. Lifestyle scores only rank, never filter. All hard constraints are checked separately. Profiles are design hypotheses confirmed by the user, not universal ergonomic rules.
